smoke.description: Run the mandatory overfit-reproduction smoke test. If it fails, walk the bisection in 03-test-prove-overfit-first.md.
smoke.template: Run the prove-overfit-first smoke test from model-training/agent-plans/next-attempt/03-test-prove-overfit-first.md. Steps: (1) Verify model-training/tests/test_overfit_reproduction.py exists; if not, create it per that doc's spec. (2) Run: conda run -n drumtomidi pytest model-training/tests/test_overfit_reproduction.py -v -s. (3) Interpret per the table in that doc. (4) If any assertion fails, use the drum-transcription-debug skill to walk the 4-test bisection.

eval.description: Evaluate a checkpoint vs ground-truth MIDI using mir_eval. Usage: /eval <ckpt_path> <audio.wav> <ground_truth.mid>
eval.template: Use the mir-eval-drum-evaluation skill and model-training/tools/eval_with_mir_eval.py. Args: $ARGUMENTS. If no ckpt was provided, ask the user which one. Load the ckpt, run inference, write predicted MIDI, then run the eval script with --tolerance 0.05. Report overall + per-class F1. Flag any class with recall=0 (Theory T4 from 01-critique-and-theories.md).

grid.description: Run the 2x2x2 bug-isolation ablation grid on dl-1.
grid.template: Execute the plan in model-training/agent-plans/next-attempt/04-test-bug-isolation-grid.md. Steps: (1) Wire feature flags into feature_extractor.py / label_encoder.py / model.py / train_utils.py. (2) Write model-training/tools/bug_isolation_grid.py. (3) Run via the training-monitor subagent (avoids 120s timeout). (4) Tabulate F1 per config. (5) Identify winning config; recommend next approach.

train-stem.description: Train one per-stem transcriber per approach 05. Usage: /train-stem <kick|snare|hihat|toms|cymbals>
train-stem.template: Follow approach 05 (model-training/agent-plans/next-attempt/05-approach-stems-as-input.md) for the stem named in $ARGUMENTS. Steps: (1) Verify per-stem dataset infra exists; create if missing per the spec. (2) Confirm the per-stem overfit smoke test passes before scaling up. (3) Spawn the training-monitor subagent to start full training (do NOT wait inline). (4) When training-monitor returns, run /eval on the resulting checkpoint.

rescue-status.description: Summarize where the model-training rescue + re-attempt stands. Useful for a fresh session.
rescue-status.template: Read model-training/agent-plans/next-attempt/00-overview.md and report concisely (max 15 lines): (1) Which approaches in 05-14 have been started (look for tools/, tests/, or new files implying work). (2) Whether model-training/tests/test_overfit_reproduction.py exists and what its last run reported. (3) Current branch and git status. (4) The strong recommendation from 00-overview.md for what to do next.
